data.gender_notes: Premprakash is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Premprakash is derived from two Sanskrit words - 'Prem' meaning love and 'Prakash' meaning light. This name signifies the presence of love and light in a person's life. The name Premprakash carries the meaning “Love and Light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Premprakash usually hope their child will grow to embody love and light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Premprakash is a powerful invocation of the divine presence of love and light in one's life. It is believed to bring blessings of peace, happiness, and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Premprakash belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Love and Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Premprakash total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

historical_references.reference: Premprakash was a popular name for Jain monks during the 12th and 13th centuries in India. The name refers to the inner light or purity of the soul, often described as the 'inner Prem' and the 'inner Prakash'.

Premprakash was also a renowned poet and philosopher in the 15th century in Northern India. He was a follower of the Nath Yoga tradition and is known for his works on the spiritual path and self-realization.
